headline: Executive order tells federal agencies to use behavioral science research to improve how government programs serve the public.
what_it_does: This order directs federal agencies to use findings from behavioral science, the study of how people make decisions, when designing and running government programs. The goal stated in the title is to serve the public better. No summary was provided, so the specific requirements and details are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are directed to apply behavioral science research when designing and running their programs.

who_it_affects.group: People who use federal programs and services
who_it_affects.how: The way some government programs and forms are designed or offered to them may change.
